integrity: The statement is supported by a combinatorial infinite-family proof plus two independently constructed finite verification programs and their recorded outputs. Finite checks alone are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: For balanced crown graphs with n>=5 and minimum closed-neighborhood identifying codes under one adjacency-restricted token slide only. No diameter theorem for n>=7; relevant 2020 scalar-minimum paper full text inaccessible; complete novelty priority unverified.
title: Sharp slide-connectivity threshold for optimum identifying codes on crown graphs
